name: Horizon launcher 0.2.56
body:
### New
- Content mods: choose light emission per block state (#11068, fixes #11063)
- Launcher: a registry project's GitHub stars as a star, in the list and the card (#12670, fixes #12665)
- Port pack: Lithostitched add_features/remove_features modifiers become NeoForge biome modifiers (#12695, fixes #12694)
- Port pack: Lithostitched weighted_selector features become 26.3's weighted_random_selector (#12700, fixes #12698)

### Fixed
- Launcher: native mod version follow-ups (kept versions, build fallback, changelogs) (#12535, fixes #12534)
- Launcher Shop: draw the items on its pictures, no Buy on an owned pack (#12675, fixes #12674)
- datafix: prepare the 1.13 data fixer tables from the player's jar (#12756, fixes #12745)
- Prepare: find Prism Launcher's flat `meta/net.minecraft/<version>.json` (#12601, fixes #12582)
- launcher: let the wheel reach the page when an inner list cannot scroll that way (#12658, fixes #12650)
- launcher: the sidebar's update card and Discord button wrap long translations (#12646, fixes #12645)
- Launcher on Windows: a program running from a version keeps it in use (#12596, fixes #12588)
- Fix Czech translation (typos, grammar, terminology) (#12635, fixes #12585)
- Registry: a new icon is a new address (#12667, fixes #12663)
- Launcher: find a Java installed on the Windows PATH (#12692, fixes #12688)
- Port pack: block state variants take 1.21.1's string booleans and numbers ("uvlock": "true") (#12697, fixes #12696)
- Launcher: Find mods lists what works on the instance; builds start on its Horizon (#12710, fixes #12709)
- servers: prevent child pipes hanging on Windows and use REST API for server controls (#12567)

### Contributors
Thanks to @Art34222, @Delete228, @ItzKubass, @Joansitoh, @RINNECODER, @devtalh, @hildlabs, @iseaprojects, @oloion, @umbx-dot.

name: Nightly 2026-11-07 · 2ebf00a
body:
Want to play? Download the Horizon launcher.

Do NOT run the files below. They will not work on their own.

The launcher installs this version and keeps it up to date. You need your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The files below are what the launcher installs, and the dedicated server for people who host one.

Nightly 2026-11-07 · 2ebf00a: main (2ebf00a), built from `nightly/build-2026-11-07-2` (2ebf00a0281c592f79191e76fce0e7d522c6f425). Source: commit 2ebf00a0281c592f79191e76fce0e7d522c6f425, kept for good as the tag `nightly-source/2026-11-07-2ebf00a`; horizon-source.tar.gz is its tree. Native mods built for this Nightly pin that commit. The launcher installs it by itself; your worlds stay as they are. A Nightly can include pull requests the Team picked before they are merged (below). Report bugs with the version the game shows ("Nightly · "). ### New - Controllers: the gameplay guide, what the buttons do now, in play and in inventories (#10305) ### Fixed - horizon-client: discord, friends and heartbeat features (default on) (#11550, fixes #11539) - Recipes: preserve the search footer when returning from a recipe (#11443, main merged) (#11773, fixes #11441) - Realms: the subscription, settings and invite codes read what the service sends (#11640) - Expose native HUD mode with independent hand visibility (#11587, fixes #11123) - Omit empty Tags from modeled entity saves (#10291, fixes #10284) - Fix dropped-item Health short conversion (#10344, fixes #10296) - Save spectral arrow duration and its default (#10290, fixes #10257) - Entity saves: a warden's anger keeps its suspects by UUID (#10365) Thanks to @MSedgeMC, @TheMrZZ, @martipops, @masa-masa-0314, @socksprox, @voidsipp. Not an official Minecraft product.
